# xlsx_writer v0.10.0 - Table of Contents

> A fast Elixir library for writing Excel (.xlsx) files using Rust. Built with the rust_xlsxwriter crate via Rustler NIF for high performance spreadsheet generation.

## Pages

- Guides
  - [Getting Started with XlsxWriter](https://xlsx-writer.hexdocs.pm/getting_started.md)
  - [Builder API Guide](https://xlsx-writer.hexdocs.pm/builder_api.md)
  - [Advanced Formatting Guide](https://xlsx-writer.hexdocs.pm/formatting.md)
  - [Layout Features Guide](https://xlsx-writer.hexdocs.pm/layout_features.md)

## Modules

- [XlsxWriter](https://xlsx-writer.hexdocs.pm/XlsxWriter.md): A high-performance library for creating Excel xlsx files in Elixir.
- [XlsxWriter.Builder](https://xlsx-writer.hexdocs.pm/XlsxWriter.Builder.md): A high-level builder API for creating Excel files without manually tracking cell positions.
- [XlsxWriter.Validation](https://xlsx-writer.hexdocs.pm/XlsxWriter.Validation.md): Validation functions for XlsxWriter inputs.
- [XlsxWriter.WorkbookProperties](https://xlsx-writer.hexdocs.pm/XlsxWriter.WorkbookProperties.md): Document properties for an Excel workbook.
